_comment: Every condition the 2026-11-16 verdict attached to Phase 2A, with its current state and the predicate that keeps that state honest. scripts/check_conditions.py evaluates every check on each gate run, so a closed condition cannot be re-opened by a silent registry edit and an open one cannot be described as satisfied. A condition is CLOSED only when a check enforces the state it required, not merely because the builder says so.

conditions.title: typescript_symbol_index stays R2 until wired into build_repo_query()
conditions.evidence: TypeScript extraction is wired into build_repo_query(); the capability is GREEN/R3 with three probes, one of which is the product surface (tests/trust_surfaces.rs::repo_symbols_returns_a_typescript_symbol).

conditions.title: repository_benchmark and documentation_accuracy must remain R2/DISPUTED
conditions.evidence: Closed by turning the requirement into a standing invariant rather than a note: the two entries are DISPUTED/R2 and the checks below fail the gate if either is promoted without a new audit. Closing C2 promotes nothing; it makes the auditor's ruling enforced instead of remembered.

conditions.title: the three GREEN/R2 conflicts are resolved (observation_loop, repair_loop, test_model_client)
conditions.evidence: Resolved by downgrading all three to PARTIAL rather than by claiming a rung the recorded evidence does not support. Section 4.2 of the capability model forbids GREEN below R3.

conditions.title: the benchmark question set must become independently authored
conditions.evidence: No independently authored set exists. The checkable scope is: any question set committed under docs/benchmarks/ must carry a freeze lock, and the register's satisfied_by path must exist and be locked before C4 can close. An empty directory passes the check and leaves the condition OPEN, which is the honest state.

conditions.title: throughput has a collapse floor, not an acceptance budget
conditions.evidence: The owner authorised the exception (remediation item P0.4). The check asserts the floor still exists in the benchmark and is not silently raised into an acceptance claim.

conditions.title: symbol resolution remains regex-based (DEFINITION_INDEXED only)
conditions.evidence: No reference resolution exists. The check asserts the limitation is stated where the engine reports it, so the report cannot later imply call-graph knowledge it does not have.
